title: On All the Saints
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: MGR Greek extract (TLG 2063.010 / Documenta Catholica Omnia); whole sermon; PG 10.1200–1204 cues
blurb: A sermon for All Saints, attributed to Gregory Thaumaturgus, in a fresh English translation of the whole sermon. Scholars dispute the attribution.
era_note: Transmitted under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name; authenticity is disputed and disclosed.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 6 Salmond, PD); this is a fresh English translation of the whole sermon from the Greek.

text_history.method: English follows the MGR Greek extract for the whole sermon. ANF 6 was consulted only as a sense check for the opening; the rest was translated from the Greek alone.

witnesses.name: MGR / Documenta Catholica Omnia extract
witnesses.coverage: Whole sermon; sections 2–3 read from this print

witnesses.name: Locked Greek text of the opening
